description: This file implements a Python class `GoogleLLMOpenAIBetaService` that provides a service interface for Google's AI large language models (like Gemini) using an OpenAI-compatible API structure. It manages streaming responses, function call handling, and token usage metrics, acting as a wrapper around Google's generative language API to facilitate integration with systems designed for OpenAI's API.

classes.name: GoogleLLMOpenAIBetaService
classes.description: A service class that integrates Google's AI LLM models via an OpenAI-compatible API format, handling streaming, function calls, and metrics for Google Gemini and similar models.
